title: The src-layer Vitest DB tripwire built the protected folder without resolving <repo>/data, so a data folder that is a junction or symlink was not protected at this layer
severity_rationale: S3, equal to the estimate: the setup-layer rail still caught it; one layer of two was weaker than stated.

evidence.note: the fix: both the repo-root-joined and the resolved data folder are compared

sibling_sites_checked: The setup layer (test/rails/core.cjs) already compared the canonical data folder, so the path was still blocked in tests.
